hero.title2: The books take care of themselves.
hero.subtitle: FINORA posts a double-entry journal for every document, with Thai VAT, withholding tax and 50 Tawi certificates — and shows you exactly what will be recorded before you post. On the web, iOS and Android.
hero.note: Multiple companies in one account · invite your team and accountant

features.title: Everything your business needs, in one place
features.subtitle: Simple enough for non-accountants on day one — rigorous enough for your accountant to trust every number.

items.title: Live posting simulation
items.body: See what a document will record — in plain language, as a journal and as T-accounts. Expand it to full screen.

items.title: Automatic double entry
items.body: Invoices, receipts, expenses, credit and debit notes — posted with the same rules, every time.

items.title: Thai VAT done right
items.body: VAT-exclusive or inclusive, deferred output/input VAT for services, released automatically as you get paid or pay.

items.title: Withholding tax + 50 Tawi
items.body: Pick the income type per line, support payer-borne tax, and get the 50 Tawi certificate as a PDF instantly.

items.title: Tax invoice PDFs + share links
items.body: Original and copy in proper Thai. Email it or share a link your customer can open without an account.

items.title: Snap bills on your phone
items.body: Attach photos or files to any document, so every piece of evidence is in one place.

how.title: From document to books in 3 steps

steps.title: Create documents the way you're used to
steps.body: Choose a customer, add lines — VAT, withholding tax and the net amount are calculated as you type. No debits or credits needed.

steps.title: See the result before you post
steps.body: The simulation explains how receivables, revenue and tax will change — and what happens when you're paid. It uses the very same rules as real posting.

steps.title: Post, share and follow up
steps.body: Get gap-free document numbers, send a PDF or link, track unpaid and overdue invoices, and record partial payments.

trust.title: Numbers you can trust from the first entry
trust.subtitle: The key accounting rules live in the database, not just the screen — so every channel follows the same rules.

items.title: Double entry, always
items.body: The database rejects any entry where debits don't equal credits.

items.title: Posted means final
items.body: Posted documents can only be voided with a reversal. Numbers never repeat or skip.

items.title: Full audit trail
items.body: An audit log records who did what, and when.

items.title: Isolated per company
items.body: Row-Level Security on every table, plus owner / admin / accountant / staff / viewer roles.
